review_text_raw: Jumpa Asa is an outstanding cafe in Jatinangor. The atmosphere is very comfortable and not very noisy. Unlike many other cafes in Jatinangor, this one has a good amount of indoor space with AC. The seats are comfortable for long work/study sessions. They even offer tables with sofas too. Almost every indoor table gets an outlet. And the tables are very clean and feels good to write on with paper. The food is also very good for the price, especially their snacks. And their coffee actually tastes quite good, unlike many other cafes who have mid-ahh coffee that only tastes good because of all the sugar and milk they add. You can get an espresso here for only Rp 12rb and it actually tastes good and not overly bitter. Only issue is parking. The parking area is quite cramped, typically only being able to park 2-3 cars while still leaving space for motorbike parking. Very good place to hangout or to study/work. A genuine gem in Jatinangor, compared to many other cafes here which only look good for Instagram stories.

review_text_raw: Sky Resto & Café is the in-house restaurant at Skyland Hotel and Apartment Jatinangor, and honestly, it was the highlight of our stay. The view is straight to Mount Geulis—really beautiful and calming. The vibe is chill, especially in the evening when the air gets cool. The staff were all super friendly, and the breakfast buffet had a pretty good variety. For dinner, it was really convenient to just eat here—especially since it’s right inside the hotel. No need to go out and look for food, which is a big help when it’s raining or you’re just too tired to head out. Price-wise, it’s affordable. Taste-wise, it’s okay. My fettuccine carbonara was a bit too sweet, but the rest of the food was enjoyable enough. All in all, it’s a comfy spot to eat, relax, and enjoy the view without having to leave the hotel.
